title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Amos 6: the woe on those at ease in Zion and Samaria, their ivory beds and bowls of wine, and the nation Yahweh raises up against Israel.

questions.text: On which mountain does the opening woe place those who feel secure?
questions.explanation: The woe is spoken to those at ease in Zion and to those who are secure on the mountain of Samaria.

questions.text: Gath, which the hearers are told to go down to, is called the city of which people?
questions.explanation: They are told to go to Calneh, then to Hamath the great, and then down to Gath of the Philistines.

questions.text: What are the beds of the comfortable described in verse 4 made of?
questions.explanation: They lie on beds of ivory and stretch themselves out on their couches.

questions.text: Whom are those who strum on the strings of a harp compared with?
questions.explanation: They strum on the harp and invent instruments of music for themselves, like David.

questions.text: Those who drink wine in bowls and use the best oils are not grieved for what?
questions.explanation: They drink wine in bowls and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

questions.text: What does verse 7 say will happen to these people?
questions.explanation: They will go captive with the first who go captive, and the feasting and lounging will end.

answers.text: They will be given still greater riches
They will go captive with the first to go captive
They will keep their feasts for many years
They will be driven out to live in the fields

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he abhors?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh has sworn by himself that he abhors the pride of Jacob and will deliver up the city with all that is in it.

questions.text: According to verse 11, what happens when Yahweh gives the command?
questions.explanation: Yahweh commands, and the great house is smashed to pieces and the little house into bits.

answers.text: The city gates are opened to strangers
The walls of the city are built up again
Great house and little house are broken to pieces
The houses are filled with grain and oil

questions.text: What have the hearers turned justice into?
questions.explanation: They have turned justice into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will raise up against the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh, the God of Armies, says he will raise up a nation against them, which will afflict them from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of the Arabah.
